eps.t: Pilot 1 - A Day in the Life of Houston Primary School
eps.d: Chalkface follows head teacher Eileen Milton and Primaries one and seven through a typical day in a Scottish primary school.

Science teacher Betty Lee coaches the David Lloyd George basketball team - one of the school's few successes. But an away match against the deadly rivals at Queen Anne High School ends in controversy and Barbara Kent is forced to step in.
Lizzie Bowen's Special Activities session nearly ends in tragedy.
Roy Bates , Head of Science, becomes a victim of stress.
A temporary Head of Science needs to be appointed.
The school play wins a great but controversial honour and Barbara Kent faces a terrible decision.
Stephen Parker tries to chat up Melanie Clough and bites off more than he can chew.
When Stephen Parker wakes up he knows it is going to be one of those days.
End-of-term celebrations at David Lloyd George are tempered by bad news about funding. Barbara Kent decides on direct action.
